bio: This Italian restaurant has been a mainstay of Schwabing's culinary scene since 1989. The interior is modern and elegant yet cosy, with the current decor successfully incorporating the old wall tiles and original bar. The menu sticks close to the seasons. In addition to the five-course tasting menu, there is an à la carte selection – from delicious pasta dishes to branzino al sale (salt-baked sea bass) for two....
